subject.callable: direct Triton float32 in-place gradient value clipping for one buffer
subject.boundary: one launch with sixteen Triton programs reading and writing every coordinate of one contiguous 4096-element gradient buffer in place

tasks.task_statement: Update the complete received physical finite float32 gradient buffer in place by clamping every coordinate to the closed interval [-0.75, 0.75].

input_map.basis: the kernel uses the exact binary clipping bound 0.75
the direct kernel corresponds to the selected non-foreach implementation
